array.string: set -euo pipefail; SECRETS="$HOME/.nuzantara-secrets.env"; BACKEND_SECRETS="$HOME/.nuzantara-backend-secrets.env"; if [ -f "$SECRETS" ]; then set -a; . "$SECRETS"; set +a; fi; if [ -f "$BACKEND_SECRETS" ]; then set -a; . "$BACKEND_SECRETS"; set +a; fi; if [ -z "${DATABASE_URL_LOCAL:-}" ]; then echo "[wr2-daily-reconciler] ERROR: DATABASE_URL_LOCAL not set in $SECRETS" 1>&2; exit 74; fi; export DATABASE_URL="$DATABASE_URL_LOCAL"; if ! nc -z 127.0.0.1 15432 2>/dev/null; then echo "[wr2-daily-reconciler] ERROR: 127.0.0.1:15432 unreachable (pg-proxy?)" 1>&2; exit 74; fi; REPO="${WR2_REPO_ROOT:-$HOME/Desktop/nuzantara-deploy}"; PY="${WR2_HTML_VENV_PY:-$REPO/.venv-wr2-html/bin/python}"; cd "$REPO"; if [ ! -x "$PY" ]; then echo "[wr2-daily-reconciler] WARN: venv missing at $PY — auto-heal via setup_wr2_html_venv.sh (scar W81/html-venv)" 1>&2; if ! bash "$REPO/scripts/setup_wr2_html_venv.sh" 1>&2; then echo "[wr2-daily-reconciler] ERROR: venv auto-heal failed" 1>&2; exit 75; fi; fi; exec "$PY" "$REPO/scripts/wr2_daily_reconciler.py"
